details: Importing ai-persona-sdk runs an obfuscated loader: index.mjs loads personas.mjs, which loads cache-warm.mjs and build-cache.mjs. build-cache.mjs hides a single 199 KB line behind 2,000 spaces and ends in an indirect eval. Its decoded string tables show it reading npm, git, AWS, SSH, Kubernetes and gcloud credentials, adding persistence (a cron @reboot entry, authorized_keys, sudoers), force-pushing to the victim's git repositories as dependabot[bot], and using the host cdn.node-js.dev.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: 1.0.0: Obfuscated payload: one 199 KB line after 2,000 spaces on line 2, ending in an indirect eval.
1.0.0: Obfuscated loader reached from index.mjs through personas.mjs on import.
